title: a to-do list JSON API (held out)

roles.name: pm
roles.doc: Product manager: talks to the client, writes and runs tests.

roles.name: rules
roles.doc: Writes the business rules (rules.py): validation and ordering.

client.answer: POST /api/todos with {"title", "priority"} creates a to-do and answers 201 with {"id", "title", "priority", "done"}. Ids are 1, 2, 3 ... in order of creation; done starts false.
Titles are trimmed of spaces. An empty title or one longer than 80 characters is refused with 400. A title that already exists (ignoring upper/lower case) is refused with 409.
Priority is one of high, normal, low; when it is missing it is normal. Anything else is a 400.
GET /api/todos returns every to-do: high first, then normal, then low; within a priority, oldest (smallest id) first.
PATCH /api/todos/<id> with {"done": true or false} sets it and answers 200 with the to-do. An id that does not exist is 404, and so is any path we did not talk about.

features.text: Refuse bad to-dos the way the client wants.
List to-dos in the client's order.
Mark to-dos done or not done.
